name: Teen Ambassadors
what_you_do: Teens learn the history of their own neighborhood. They practice public speaking and interviews and visit old buildings. Then they work as guides at the Open House Chicago festival in October.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 10 to 12. Two neighborhood groups are listed: Bronzeville and Uptown.
duration: Several weeks, ending with the October Open House Chicago festival (exact dates not stated)
deadline_text: 2026 round: priority deadline August 21, notices August 25, confirm by August 31. The page says it is sold out.
how_to_apply: The page has no link to apply. Email caclearning@architecture.org.
notes: Pay and the 2027 dates are not posted. Email to ask when the next group opens.
